title: Lantern Deep Runner
heading: Lantern Deep
help: Pick a step, click Green flag, and dig with the arrow keys (U buys a pickaxe from step 5).

1.name: Rows of squares
1.note: The Square sprite sets its own variables, then clones itself: each clone keeps a copy.

2.name: Dig with a pick
2.note: An invisible Pick goes to the square you face; the square touching it takes the hit.

3.name: Scroll down forever
3.note: Everything moves up by scroll; new rows below, old rows above are deleted.

4.name: In the dark
4.note: Squares show what they are only when the Lantern touches them. Treasure gives coins.

5.name: Better pickaxes
5.note: U buys a pickaxe that hits twice as hard (40, 150, 500 coins).

6.name: Lava and hearts
6.note: Lava from row 16 costs a heart; then a short safe time.

7.name: Cave crawlers
7.note: Caves from row 20, with crawlers walking to and fro. This is the whole game.
